json.title: show main categories
json.prompt:
Here are our main service options:

%MAIN_CATEGORIES%

Which of these services are you interested in?

json.title: show subcategories
json.prompt:
Under "%SELECTED_MAIN_CATEGORY%", we offer the following options:

%SUBCATEGORIES%

Which of these would work best for you?

json.title: show services
json.prompt:
In "%SELECTED_SUBCATEGORY%", we have these services available:

%SERVICES%

Would you like to choose one and book an appointment?

title: Show Services
description:
Only begin this flow if the user clearly expresses intent to learn about the services offered — such as asking what the master or salon provides, or requesting a list of available treatments.

This intent must be explicit and unambiguous — the user should clearly want to see what’s available.

✅ Examples of valid intent:

“What do you offer?”

“What services do you have?”

“What does this master do?”

“What treatments are available here?”

“Can you show me the services?”
call_to_action_prompt:
If the user mentions a situation or need without clearly asking about services, gently clarify:
Would you like me to show what services we offer?
